title: Daily Lesson Streak and XP
dataSources: Lessons (`lesson:complete`), vocab reviews (`vocab:review`), immersion (`immersion:log`), speaking practice (`speaking:session`).
app: Language-learning telemetry — Duolingo / Babbel lesson exports, Anki spaced-repetition review logs, immersion trackers, and speaking-practice logs — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lesson:complete
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(xp) as xp, count as lessons by _time
| streamstats current=t sum(eval(if(lessons>0,1,0))) as streak reset_after="(lessons=0)"
| sort - _time
description: Tracks your daily language-lesson streak and XP, the habit engine behind long-term fluency.
value: Language learning rewards daily consistency above all; a visible streak is exactly what sustains it.
implementation: Ingest lesson completions into `index=personal`; surface daily XP and the streak.
visualization: Calendar heatmap of study days with the current streak.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks your daily language-study streak, the steady habit that builds fluency over time.
